en: Seeker is a spatial intelligence layer for complex indoor spaces.
zh: Seeker 是一个针对复杂室内空间的空间智能层。

zh: 有了 Seeker,我们仅凭你手机的摄像头就能找到你的精确位置，精度达到厘米级，无需安装任何硬件，而且我们在没有 GPS 的地方表现最好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Precise positioning is still a challenge, especially for industries such as indoor wayfinding, last mile deliveries, and also physical AI bots.
zh: 精确定位仍然是一个挑战，尤其是对室内导航、最后一公里配送，以及实体 AI 机器人等行业而言。

speaker: Unknown
en: We come in, we take a 3D scan of the place, our algorithm turns that scan into a precise map, and then we go live, where visitors get the live navigation and venue operators get the live movement data.
zh: 我们进场，对场地进行 3D 扫描，我们的算法把扫描结果转化为精确的地图，然后我们上线，访客获得实时导航，场馆运营方获得实时移动数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: We build maps six times faster and in real time.
zh: 我们建图的速度快六倍，而且是实时的。

zh: 我们可以用 LiDAR,或者只用照片，甚至只用场地的视频来完成。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what we do is clearly like something that engineers don't have to manually annotate because our visual positioning system makes sure and takes care of repeated structures, closed loops and also narrow spaces.
zh: 我们做的事情显然不需要工程师手动标注，因为我们的视觉定位系统会处理并搞定重复结构、闭环以及狭窄空间。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we're live at the Hong Kong International Airport where it took us two weeks to go from scanning to deployment.

speaker: Unknown
en: We're also covering the Plug and Play Silicon Valley Summit where 4,000 exhibition goers will be using Seeker to navigate the three-day conference.
zh: 我们还在为 Plug and Play 硅谷峰会提供覆盖，4,000 名观展者将使用 Seeker 在这场为期三天的会议中导航。

en: Our technology is so precise that even a blind user can navigate just by our audio and haptic feedback.
zh: 我们的技术非常精确，即使是盲人用户也仅凭我们的音频和触觉反馈就能导航。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, operators like venue operators get real-time data such as visitor flow, dwell time, and also dynamic rerouting options.
zh: 而且，你知道，像场馆运营方这样的运营方能获得实时数据，比如访客流量、停留时间，以及动态改道选项。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the indoor navigation space is a $31 billion opportunity, and we are positioned to capture 1,800 venues that opens up revenue of about $500 million.
zh: 室内导航是一个 310 亿美元的市场机会，我们有望拿下 1,800 个场馆，带来约 5 亿美元的收入。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we built Seeker because we've got family members that are visually impaired and we wanted them to navigate indoor spaces independently.
zh: 我们打造 Seeker 是因为我们有视障的家人，我们希望他们能独立地在室内空间中导航。

speaker: Unknown
en: But what we've built is one map that both people and machines can read.
zh: 但我们打造的其实是人机都能读取的一张地图。
